objective.path: 研究方案/09 Level3 自由探索最终方案.md

prior_registration.role: historical scope; not a launch substitute

target: SGLang Spark-X2.6-1.7B GGUF Q8_0 on isolated NVIDIA GB10

domains.remaining_work: Independent Level 3 driver; connect model and transport to the whole-tree workflow, and checkpoint abnormal exits without dropping or double-counting usage.
dependencies: E checkpoint and F accounting and stop interfaces

A1.pass: Verify current official provider contract. Under real Pi offline replay inspect the outbound request for model ID, enabled thinking, Max, 393216 output, SSE and intact reasoning replay; bind Pi version, config and actual provider fingerprint from an authorized real response. Bind existing scoped long-SSE and 1205-second silent-upstream evidence if transport identity is unchanged, else exercise the changed layer. Do not induce a huge paid generation.

A2.pass: With real Pi and injected length, context admission, network loss and guest/worker failures, record terminal cause, reconcile or conservatively mark unknown usage, execute no incomplete tool, verify recovery from a bound checkpoint within the shared ceiling, and repeat with missing/corrupt checkpoint to prove fail closed.

domains.remaining_work: Controlled host research RPC for search, paper/read and public reference source; provenance cache; true target/guest discovery; locked dependencies in an isolated environment.
dependencies: Documented public source adapters and fees

B1.pass: Call search and read for one real public web result, fetch and page one real paper body, and read/reference-checkout public source at one exact Git commit. Reopen from immutable cache; record content hashes, canonical URL, retrieval time/version, attribution or unknown license, bytes, retrieval attempts and charges.

B2.pass: Observe actual GB10 hardware/software, target and launch configuration and remaining limits through the trusted interface; distinguish guest from worker. Install and use a hash-locked required Python or Node dependency in a fresh isolated environment without agent-side network access.

B3.pass: Reject local/private/internal/credential-bearing destinations, disallowed redirects and protected research/evaluation artifacts. Prove content containing instructions remains inert data and downloaded reference/dependency material has no automatic execution or prompt privilege.

domains.remaining_work: Pinned full source, editable Native artifacts, bounded programmable diagnostics, verifiable Native deployment and profiling, and multi-version/branch operations.
dependencies: Pinned full tree/overlay and offline wheels
Isolated ARM64 GB10 build and runtime image

C1.pass: Use real Pi with mocked upstream to discover and page the full pinned tree, submit one multi-file edit including Python, Triton, CUDA, C++ and a build parameter, and verify content identity at materialization. Save two branches from a parent, restore each, and prove protected paths/unregistered bytes cannot cross into the candidate.

C2.pass: Execute an agent-authored bounded diagnostic under isolated leases and label it non-scoring. A trusted profile run records timeline, kernel and launch/synchronization evidence plus TTFT/TPOT/throughput and counter availability; missing unsupported optional counters are explicit.

C3.pass: Run the preregistered positive Native fixture through cold and incremental compile, isolated deploy, quality and four-scene measure. Record build cost/flags/toolchain/cache identity and prove the changed path really executed, not merely loaded. Independently cold-build E0 twice in production-of-evidence parity with candidates, bind identities and explain nonidentical bytes.

domains.remaining_work: Extend bounded G0/G1 to Native; preregister distinct held-out exploratory Q/T protocol and paired E0 noise policy; isolate profiling and diagnostics from scoring.
dependencies: Trusted frozen fixtures, candidate-independent observations and holdout lock

D1.pass: Approve and hash the exploratory held-out Q/T protocol before opening launch. Prove custom diagnostics and D cannot access Q/T, Q/T is separate from future RQ-A, and final Q/T is evaluated only after sealing delivery, never returned to the Agent for selection.

D2.pass: Run preregistered legal and representative Native compute-negative controls plus EOS, vocabulary, mixed request/KV isolation and quantized residency negatives. Verify expected detection, external weight hash and memory/output evidence, and correctness on the actual timing configuration. Missing evidence is distinct from rejection; document residual detection limits.

D3.pass: Preregister E0 stability, pair order, repeat count and acceptance criteria; run E0/E0 noise calibration with separate exclusively measured W1–W4 windows and no profiler. Bind all metrics/engine identities and preserve raw per-scene values and equal-weight ratios.

domains.remaining_work: Dual objective and ordinary transition, isolated research-state handoff, Harness verification/activation, and explicit final choice not tied to first quality pass.

E1.pass: Use real Pi and scripted upstream to submit, validate/load-test and activate a fixture Harness. On normal Agent-requested continuation (not failure), prove a fresh Pi loads, exposes and invokes the new component; also test continued H0 and active-version rollback. The dual-goal prompt neither requires a Harness update nor discloses fixture solutions.

E2.pass: Replay selected qualified E, active H, trusted M_E, tagged untrusted M_H/R, and explicitly saved WIP into a fresh segment; exclude old Pi state, unregistered files and sealed data. A WIP-only or missing-state delivery is rejected. Distinguish qualify, measure, checkpoint, normal continue, abnormal recovery and final delivery; chosen legal artifact may be slower than historical best.

domains.remaining_work: Cross-segment resource event catalog, source/license checks, layered fault reporting and explicit end-to-end emergency stop with settlement and cleanup.

F1.pass: Reconcile successful and unsuccessful API, Research, dependency, build, deploy, diagnostics/profile, quality, measure, checkpoint and restore operations against immutable receipts and artifact/policy/model identities. Distinguish usage from reservations and estimates, classify failures or unknown, and retain unsuccessful costs without manufacturing a performance value.

F2.pass: Exercise a manual stop during each active lane (Pi/provider, Research, build/diagnostic, GPU); record cancellation and verified cleanup or quarantine/uncertain settlement with no next dispatch. Verify credentials, production data and holdout boundaries. Check all prospective live work against explicit scope plus caps; fail closed without separately recorded authorization.
